bio.text: Mark DeSaulnier represents California's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House, which includes much of Contra Costa County and part of Alameda County.
He was born in Lowell, Massachusetts, lives in Concord, California, and earned a B.A. in history from the College of the Holy Cross in 1974.
He served on the Contra Costa County Board of Supervisors and as mayor of Concord, in the California State Assembly (2006-2008) and in the California State Senate (2008-2014).
His House website says he has more than 30 years in public service and as a small business owner; he is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
